#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * check-db-doors.mjs — ONE way to talk to the database (data layer design, step 1).
 *
 * `@ai-matrx/data` owns the connection, the session and every database operation.
 * This guard reports every DIRECT database call outside it, per file, across every
 * app that talks to the platform database:
 *
 *   aidream apps/shared/*  ·  matrx-frontend  ·  matrx-extend  ·  matrx-local  ·  matrx-vscode
 *
 * Parsed with the TypeScript compiler API (an AST, not a regex): multi-line chains,
 * type arguments (`.from<Row>("t")`), element access (`sb["rpc"](…)`), destructured
 * `rpc`, template-literal tables and comments are all read the way the compiler reads them.
 *
 * Shapes (every git-tracked JS/TS file — tests, scripts, work/tmp/out/build included: real code):
 *   from-literal   `.from("table")`            (not Array/Buffer/typed-array/stream `.from`, not `.storage.from`)
 *   from-dynamic   `.from(variable)`           a runtime-chosen table
 *   rpc            `.rpc(`
 *   schema         `.schema("x")` / `.schema(var).from|rpc`
 *   storage        `.storage.from(`
 *   auth           `.auth.<session/sign-in call>`
 *   client         `createClient(` (in a file importing @supabase/*), `createBrowserClient(`,
 *                  `createServerClient(`, `createAdminClient(`
 *   supabase-import a value import from `@supabase/*` (type-only imports are free)
 *   channel        `.channel(` outside @ai-matrx/realtime
 *   rest           a `/rest/v1` URL (a hand-rolled PostgREST fetch)
 *
 * Homes (exempt): aidream `apps/shared/data/**` (everything); `apps/shared/realtime/**`
 * (channel + @supabase import). Excluded: node_modules, dist, .next, vendor, `.d.ts`,
 * generated types, this guard and its fixture. Browser acceptance tests in
 * matrx-extend may name PostgREST URLs to observe and verify real wire traffic;
 * that one REST shape is exempt there, while database SDK calls remain counted.
 *
 * Existing sites are a SHRINK-ONLY per-file baseline (db-doors-baseline.json).
 * REPORT-ONLY today: exit 0 with the report; `--strict` exits 1 on any file over its
 * baseline (the blocking mode each repo flips to as it reaches zero — design step 9).
 *
 *   node apps/shared/scripts/check-db-doors.mjs                report (per repo, per shape, growth)
 *   node apps/shared/scripts/check-db-doors.mjs --strict       exit 1 on growth
 *   node apps/shared/scripts/check-db-doors.mjs --self-test    planted call in a fixture copy: red, then green
 *   node apps/shared/scripts/check-db-doors.mjs --prune-baseline   lower/drop entries only (never raises)
 *   node apps/shared/scripts/check-db-doors.mjs --seed-baseline    only when no baseline exists
 *   node apps/shared/scripts/check-db-doors.mjs --rebaseline "<why>"  ONLY when the counting method changes
 *   --json                                                     machine-readable summary
 *   --repo <key>   count ONE repo (matrx-frontend, matrx-extend, …) — what each repo's own release
 *                  gate runs with --strict: a file over its baseline fails, a new file starts at zero.
 *                  The repo not checked out here exits 2 (UNMEASURED), never a pass.
 *   --repo-dir <path>   with --repo, scan that checkout rather than the sibling of aidream.
 *                       Release snapshots use this to validate their own frozen source.
 *
 * A repo that is not checked out next to aidream is skipped and named (never a pass for it).
 */
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import {
  cpSync,
  existsSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  readFileSync,
  readdirSync,
  realpathSync,
  statSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const AIDREAM = path.resolve(HERE, '../../..');
const CODE = path.resolve(AIDREAM, '..');
const BASELINE = path.join(HERE, 'db-doors-baseline.json');
const FIXTURE = path.join(HERE, 'fixtures', 'db-doors');
// A consumer release installs its own compiler, not aidream's package dependencies.
// Use the explicitly selected checkout; fleet scans retain the data package compiler.
const compilerArgs = process.argv.slice(2);
const compilerRepoDir = compilerArgs.includes('--repo-dir')
  ? compilerArgs[compilerArgs.indexOf('--repo-dir') + 1]
  : null;
const compilerPackage =
  compilerRepoDir && !compilerRepoDir.startsWith('--')
    ? path.resolve(compilerRepoDir, 'package.json')
    : path.join(HERE, '..', 'data', 'package.json');
const ts = createRequire(compilerPackage)('typescript');

/** repo key → { dir, pathspec } */
export const REPOS = {
  aidream: { dir: AIDREAM, pathspec: ['apps/shared'] },
  'matrx-frontend': { dir: path.join(CODE, 'matrx-frontend'), pathspec: ['.'] },
  'matrx-extend': { dir: path.join(CODE, 'matrx-extend'), pathspec: ['.'] },
  'matrx-local': { dir: path.join(CODE, 'matrx-local'), pathspec: ['.'] },
  'matrx-vscode': { dir: path.join(CODE, 'matrx-vscode'), pathspec: ['.'] },
};

const CODE_FILE = /\.(?:ts|tsx|mts|cts|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$/;
const EXCLUDED =
  /(?:^|\/)(?:node_modules|dist|\.next|\.wt|\.matrx|vendor)\/|\.d\.[cm]?ts$|\.generated\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$|(?:^|\/)database\.types\.ts$|^apps\/shared\/scripts\/(?:check-db-doors\.mjs|fixtures\/db-doors\/)/;

/** Files that ARE the data layer (exempt from every shape). */
const DATA_HOME = /^apps\/shared\/data\//;
/** The realtime package owns `.channel(` and its own @supabase import. */
const REALTIME_HOME = /^apps\/shared\/realtime\//;

/** Receivers whose `.from(` is never a table. */
const NOT_A_TABLE_RECEIVER =
  /^(?:Array|Buffer|Object|Set|Map|Readable|Iterator|Observable|Blob|Promise|String|Stream|Duplex|rxjs|Rx|Temporal\.\w+|[A-Z]\w*Array)$/;
const DBISH = /supabase|client|\bdb\b|\bsb\b|admin|scoped|schema\(/i;
const AUTH_METHODS = new Set(
  'getSession getUser getClaims signInWithPassword signInWithOAuth signInWithOtp signInWithIdToken signInWithSSO signInAnonymously signUp signOut onAuthStateChange updateUser refreshSession setSession exchangeCodeForSession verifyOtp resetPasswordForEmail reauthenticate resend linkIdentity unlinkIdentity getUserIdentities admin mfa startAutoRefresh stopAutoRefresh'.split(
    ' ',
  ),
);
const TABLE_NAME = /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*(?:\.[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)?$/;
const QUICK = /from|rpc|schema|auth|Client|@supabase|channel|rest\/v1/;
const kindOf = (file) =>
  /\.tsx$|\.jsx$/.test(file)
    ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX
    : /\.[cm]?js$/.test(file)
      ? ts.ScriptKind.JS
      : ts.ScriptKind.TS;

function calleeName(callee) {
  if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(callee)) return callee.name.text;
  if (ts.isElementAccessExpression(callee) && ts.isStringLiteralLike(callee.argumentExpression))
    return callee.argumentExpression.text;
  if (ts.isIdentifier(callee)) return callee.text;
  return null;
}
const receiverOf = (callee) =>
  ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(callee) || ts.isElementAccessExpression(callee)
    ? callee.expression
    : null;
const isStringy = (n) => !!n && (ts.isStringLiteral(n) || ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(n));

/** Is this call's result chained into a query verb (`.from(x).select(…)`)? */
function chainedIntoQuery(call) {
  const p = call.parent;
  return (
    !!p &&
    ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(p) &&
    p.expression === call &&
    /^(?:select|insert|update|upsert|delete)$/.test(p.name.text)
  );
}

/**
 * Find every direct database call in one file's text. `home` is the exemption set
 * that applies to the file ({ data, realtime }).
 * @returns {{ line: number, shape: string }[]}
 */
export function findDbCalls(source, home = {}, file = 'x.ts') {
  if (home.data || !QUICK.test(source)) return [];
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(file, source, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, kindOf(file));
  const hits = [];
  const hit = (node, shape) =>
    hits.push({ line: sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart(sf)).line + 1, shape });
  const importsSupabase = /["']@supabase\//.test(source);
  const destructuredRpc = new Set();

  const visit = (node) => {
    if (
      ts.isImportDeclaration(node) &&
      isStringy(node.moduleSpecifier) &&
      node.moduleSpecifier.text.startsWith('@supabase/') &&
      !home.realtime
    ) {
      const clause = node.importClause;
      const typeOnly =
        clause &&
        (clause.isTypeOnly ||
          (!clause.name &&
            clause.namedBindings &&
            ts.isNamedImports(clause.namedBindings) &&
            clause.namedBindings.elements.every((e) => e.isTypeOnly)));
      if (!typeOnly) hit(node, 'supabase-import');
    } else if (ts.isBindingElement(node) && ts.isObjectBindingPattern(node.parent)) {
      const prop = node.propertyName ?? node.name;
      if (ts.isIdentifier(prop) && prop.text === 'rpc') {
        hit(node, 'rpc');
        if (ts.isIdentifier(node.name)) destructuredRpc.add(node.name.text);
      }
    } else if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(node) && AUTH_METHODS.has(node.name.text)) {
      const inner = node.expression;
      // `admin` / `mfa` are sub-APIs (`.auth.admin.createUser(…)`): only a further member access
      // counts, so a plain object's `input.auth?.admin ?? false` is not a session call.
      const subApi = node.name.text === 'admin' || node.name.text === 'mfa';
      if (
        ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(inner) &&
        inner.name.text === 'auth' &&
        (!subApi || ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(node.parent))
      )
        hit(node, 'auth');
    } else if (
      !home.browserAcceptance &&
      (ts.isStringLiteral(node) ||
        ts.isNoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral(node) ||
        ts.isTemplateHead(node) ||
        ts.isTemplateMiddle(node) ||
        ts.isTemplateTail(node)) &&
      node.text.includes('/rest/v1')
    ) {
      hit(node, 'rest');
    } else if (ts.isCallExpression(node)) {
      const callee = node.expression;
      const name = calleeName(callee);
      const recv = receiverOf(callee);
      const arg = node.arguments[0];
      if (
        name === 'require' &&
        ts.isIdentifier(callee) &&
        isStringy(arg) &&
        arg.text.startsWith('@supabase/') &&
        !home.realtime
      )
        hit(node, 'supabase-import');
      else if (recv && name === 'from') {
        const recvText = recv.getText(sf);
        if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(recv) && recv.name.text === 'storage')
          hit(node, 'storage');
        else if (!NOT_A_TABLE_RECEIVER.test(recvText)) {
          const dbish = DBISH.test(recvText) || chainedIntoQuery(node);
          if (isStringy(arg)) {
            if (TABLE_NAME.test(arg.text)) hit(node, 'from-literal');
          } else if (arg && dbish) hit(node, 'from-dynamic');
        }
      } else if (recv && name === 'rpc') hit(node, 'rpc');
      else if (!recv && name && destructuredRpc.has(name)) hit(node, 'rpc');
      else if (recv && name === 'schema') {
        const p = node.parent;
        const intoQuery =
          p && ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(p) && /^(?:from|rpc)$/.test(p.name.text);
        if ((isStringy(arg) && /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/.test(arg.text)) || intoQuery)
          hit(node, 'schema');
      } else if (recv && name === 'channel' && !home.realtime) hit(node, 'channel');
      else if (
        name === 'createBrowserClient' ||
        name === 'createServerClient' ||
        name === 'createAdminClient'
      )
        hit(node, 'client');
      else if (name === 'createClient' && importsSupabase) hit(node, 'client');
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
  return hits;
}

function homeOf(repo, file) {
  if (repo === 'matrx-extend' && file.startsWith('tests/browser/'))
    return { browserAcceptance: true };
  if (repo !== 'aidream') return {};
  return { data: DATA_HOME.test(file), realtime: REALTIME_HOME.test(file) };
}

function listFiles(dir, pathspec) {
  if (existsSync(path.join(dir, '.git'))) {
    return execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '-z', '--', ...pathspec], {
      cwd: dir,
      encoding: 'utf8',
      maxBuffer: 1 << 28,
    })
      .split('\0')
      .filter(Boolean);
  }
  // Not a git checkout (the self-test fixture copy): walk it.
  const out = [];
  const walk = (rel) => {
    for (const name of readdirSync(path.join(dir, rel))) {
      const r = rel ? `${rel}/${name}` : name;
      if (statSync(path.join(dir, r)).isDirectory()) walk(r);
      else out.push(r);
    }
  };
  walk('');
  return out;
}

/** @returns {Map<string, {count:number, shapes:Record<string,number>}>} keyed "repo:path" */
export function census(repos) {
  const out = new Map();
  const skipped = [];
  for (const [repo, { dir, pathspec }] of Object.entries(repos)) {
    if (!existsSync(dir)) {
      skipped.push(repo);
      continue;
    }
    for (const file of listFiles(dir, pathspec)) {
      if (!CODE_FILE.test(file) || EXCLUDED.test(file)) continue;
      let text;
      try {
        text = readFileSync(path.join(dir, file), 'utf8');
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      const hits = findDbCalls(text, homeOf(repo, file), file);
      if (!hits.length) continue;
      const shapes = {};
      for (const h of hits) shapes[h.shape] = (shapes[h.shape] ?? 0) + 1;
      out.set(`${repo}:${file}`, { count: hits.length, shapes });
    }
  }
  return { sites: out, skipped };
}

function readBaseline(file) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).sites ?? {};
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function writeBaseline(file, sites) {
  const sorted = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(sites).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)));
  writeFileSync(
    file,
    `${JSON.stringify(
      {
        $comment:
          'SHRINK-ONLY. Direct database calls per file outside @ai-matrx/data (check-db-doors.mjs). Lower with --prune-baseline; never raise by hand — move the call onto a data door instead.',
        sites: sorted,
      },
      null,
      2,
    )}\n`,
  );
}

/** Compare a census with a baseline. @returns {{grown: string[], total:number, files:number}} */
export function compare(sites, baseline) {
  const grown = [];
  let total = 0;
  for (const [key, { count }] of sites) {
    total += count;
    const allowed = baseline[key] ?? 0;
    if (count > allowed)
      grown.push(`${key}: ${count} direct database call(s), baseline ${allowed}`);
  }
  return { grown, total, files: sites.size };
}

const pkgOf = (key) => /^aidream:apps\/shared\/([^/]+)\//.exec(key)?.[1] ?? null;

/** Growth inside an apps/shared package that has no baselined call at all (it is at zero → blocking). */
export function blockingGrowth(grown, baseline) {
  const withCalls = new Set(Object.keys(baseline).map(pkgOf).filter(Boolean));
  return grown.filter((g) => {
    const pkg = pkgOf(g.slice(0, g.indexOf(':', g.indexOf(':') + 1)));
    return pkg && !withCalls.has(pkg);
  });
}

function summarize(sites) {
  const byRepo = {};
  for (const [key, { count, shapes }] of sites) {
    const repo = key.slice(0, key.indexOf(':'));
    const row = (byRepo[repo] ??= { files: 0, calls: 0, shapes: {} });
    row.files += 1;
    row.calls += count;
    for (const [s, n] of Object.entries(shapes)) row.shapes[s] = (row.shapes[s] ?? 0) + n;
  }
  return byRepo;
}

function selfTest() {
  // 1. every shape is found; look-alikes are not.
  const planted = {
    'from-literal': [
      'const { data } = await supabase.from("notes").select("*");',
      'supabase\n  .from(\n    "notes",\n  )\n  .select("id");',
      'supabase.from<NoteRow>("notes").select("*");',
      'supabase.from(`notes`).select();',
      'sb["from"]("notes").select("*");',
    ],
    'from-dynamic': [
      'supabase\n  .from(tableName)\n  .select()',
      'db.from(`${schema}_items`).select();',
      'x.from(name).update({ a: 1 });',
    ],
    rpc: [
      'await supabase.rpc("note_folder_get_or_create", { p_name });',
      'await sb["rpc"]("touch", {});',
      "const { rpc } = supabase; await rpc('touch');",
      'await supabase\n  .rpc\n  ("touch");',
    ],
    schema: ['supabase.schema("workbench").from("notes")', 'client.schema(s).from(t)'],
    storage: ['supabase.storage.from("avatars").upload(p, f);'],
    auth: [
      'const { data } = await supabase.auth.getSession();',
      'supabase\n  .auth\n  .onAuthStateChange(cb);',
      'await admin.auth.admin.createUser({ email });',
    ],
    client: [
      'const admin = createAdminClient();',
      'import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";\nconst c = createClient(u, k);',
    ],
    'supabase-import': [
      'import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";',
      'const { createClient } = require("@supabase/supabase-js");',
    ],
    channel: ['const ch = supabase.channel("room");'],
    rest: ['await fetch(`${url}/rest/v1/notes?select=*`);', 'fetch(base + "/rest/v1/rpc/touch")'],
  };
  const lookAlikes = [
    'const flags = { admin: input.auth?.admin ?? false, mfa: target.auth.mfa };',
    'const xs = Array.from(set);',
    "const b = Buffer.from(text, 'utf8');",
    'const u = Uint8Array.from(bytes);',
    'import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";',
    'import { type SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";',
    '// supabase.from("notes") in a comment',
    '/* supabase.rpc("x") */',
    'const s = z.object({}).schema;',
    'const it = Iterator.from(gen);',
    'const label = "from(notes)";',
  ];
  const missed = Object.entries(planted)
    .flatMap(([shape, texts]) => texts.map((text) => [shape, text]))
    .filter(([shape, text]) => !findDbCalls(text).some((h) => h.shape === shape))
    .map(([shape, text]) => `${shape}: ${text}`);
  const falsePositives = lookAlikes.filter((t) => findDbCalls(t).length > 0);
  if (missed.length || falsePositives.length) {
    console.error(
      `self-test FAILED — missed shapes: ${JSON.stringify(missed)}; false positives: ${JSON.stringify(falsePositives)}`,
    );
    return 1;
  }
  if (
    findDbCalls('supabase.from("x")', { data: true }).length ||
    findDbCalls('s.channel("x")', { realtime: true }).length
  ) {
    console.error('self-test FAILED — a home was not exempt');
    return 1;
  }
  const browserAcceptance = 'fetch("/rest/v1/notes"); supabase.from("notes").select("id")';
  const acceptanceHits = findDbCalls(browserAcceptance, { browserAcceptance: true });
  if (
    acceptanceHits.length !== 1 ||
    acceptanceHits[0].shape !== 'from-literal' ||
    findDbCalls(browserAcceptance).length !== 2
  ) {
    console.error(
      'self-test FAILED — browser acceptance REST exception widened to SDK calls or production code',
    );
    return 1;
  }

  // 1b. a package at zero blocks; a package with baselined calls only reports.
  const zero = blockingGrowth(
    [
      'aidream:apps/shared/kit/src/a.ts: 1 direct database call(s), baseline 0',
      'aidream:apps/shared/chat/src/b.ts: 1 direct database call(s), baseline 0',
    ],
    {
      'aidream:apps/shared/chat/src/c.ts': 3,
    },
  );
  if (zero.length !== 1 || !zero[0].includes('/kit/')) {
    console.error(`self-test FAILED — blocking-at-zero picked ${JSON.stringify(zero)}`);
    return 1;
  }

  // 2. end to end on a COPY of the committed fixture (never a real file): green, red on a plant, green after.
  const scratch = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'db-doors-selftest-'));
  const tree = path.join(scratch, 'repo');
  cpSync(path.join(FIXTURE, 'repo'), tree, { recursive: true });
  const repos = { fixture: { dir: tree, pathspec: ['.'] } };
  const baseline = readBaseline(path.join(FIXTURE, 'baseline.json'));
  const run = () => compare(census(repos).sites, baseline);
  const before = run();
  writeFileSync(
    path.join(tree, 'src', 'planted.ts'),
    'export const rows = () => supabase.schema("workbench").from("notes").select("id");\n',
  );
  const planted1 = run();
  writeFileSync(
    path.join(tree, 'src', 'planted.ts'),
    'export const rows = () => listAll(db, notes);\n',
  );
  const after = run();
  const ok =
    before.grown.length === 0 &&
    planted1.grown.length === 1 &&
    planted1.grown[0].startsWith('fixture:src/planted.ts') &&
    after.grown.length === 0;
  console.log(
    `  fixture green before plant: ${before.grown.length === 0} (${before.total} baselined call(s))`,
  );
  console.log(
    `  red on planted call:        ${planted1.grown.length === 1} — ${planted1.grown[0] ?? 'nothing reported'}`,
  );
  console.log(`  green after the plant moves onto a door: ${after.grown.length === 0}`);
  console.log(`  scratch copy: ${scratch}`);
  if (!ok) {
    console.error('self-test FAILED — fixture run did not go green → red → green');
    return 1;
  }
  console.log(
    `self-test ok — ${Object.values(planted).flat().length} planted calls in ${Object.keys(planted).length} shapes found, ${lookAlikes.length} look-alikes ignored, fixture green → red → green`,
  );
  return 0;
}

function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (args.includes('--self-test')) return selfTest();
  const repoKey = args.includes('--repo') ? args[args.indexOf('--repo') + 1] : null;
  const repoDir = args.includes('--repo-dir') ? args[args.indexOf('--repo-dir') + 1] : null;
  if (repoKey !== null) {
    if (!repoKey || !Object.hasOwn(REPOS, repoKey)) {
      console.error(`check-db-doors: --repo takes one of ${Object.keys(REPOS).join(', ')}`);
      return 2;
    }
    if (
      args.some((a) => a === '--prune-baseline' || a === '--seed-baseline' || a === '--rebaseline')
    ) {
      console.error(
        'check-db-doors: --repo only reports; the baseline is pruned over every repo at once.',
      );
      return 2;
    }
  }
  if (repoDir !== null && (!repoKey || !repoDir || repoDir.startsWith('--'))) {
    console.error('check-db-doors: --repo-dir requires --repo and a checkout path.');
    return 2;
  }
  const selected = repoKey
    ? { [repoKey]: { ...REPOS[repoKey], ...(repoDir && { dir: path.resolve(repoDir) }) } }
    : REPOS;
  const { sites, skipped } = census(selected);
  if (repoKey && skipped.length) {
    console.error(
      `check-db-doors: UNMEASURED — ${repoKey} is not checked out at ${selected[repoKey].dir}`,
    );
    return 2;
  }
  const baseline = readBaseline(BASELINE);

  if (args.includes('--seed-baseline')) {
    if (baseline) {
      console.error('check-db-doors: a baseline exists — it only shrinks (--prune-baseline).');
      return 1;
    }
    writeBaseline(BASELINE, Object.fromEntries([...sites].map(([k, v]) => [k, v.count])));
    console.log(`check-db-doors: seeded ${sites.size} files.`);
    return 0;
  }
  if (args.includes('--rebaseline')) {
    // ONLY when the counting METHOD changes (e.g. regex → AST): the new method's census
    // replaces the old one wholesale. Never to admit a new call — move it onto a door.
    const why = args[args.indexOf('--rebaseline') + 1];
    if (!why || why.startsWith('--')) {
      console.error(
        'check-db-doors: --rebaseline "<the counting-method change>" — a reason is required',
      );
      return 1;
    }
    writeBaseline(BASELINE, Object.fromEntries([...sites].map(([k, v]) => [k, v.count])));
    console.log(`check-db-doors: rebaselined ${sites.size} files (${why}).`);
    return 0;
  }
  if (args.includes('--prune-baseline')) {
    const next = {};
    for (const [key, allowed] of Object.entries(baseline ?? {})) {
      const repo = key.slice(0, key.indexOf(':'));
      if (skipped.includes(repo)) {
        next[key] = allowed; // never prune a repo we could not see
        continue;
      }
      const now = sites.get(key)?.count ?? 0;
      if (Math.min(now, allowed) > 0) next[key] = Math.min(now, allowed);
    }
    writeBaseline(BASELINE, next);
    console.log(`check-db-doors: baseline pruned to ${Object.keys(next).length} files.`);
    return 0;
  }

  const { grown, total, files } = compare(sites, baseline ?? {});
  const byRepo = summarize(sites);
  if (args.includes('--json')) {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ total, files, byRepo, grown, skipped }, null, 2));
  } else {
    console.log(
      `check-db-doors: ${total} direct database calls in ${files} files outside @ai-matrx/data${repoKey ? ` (${repoKey})` : ''} (${args.includes('--strict') ? 'strict: a file over its baseline fails' : 'report-only'})`,
    );
    for (const [repo, row] of Object.entries(byRepo)) {
      const shapes = Object.entries(row.shapes)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
        .map(([s, n]) => `${s} ${n}`)
        .join(', ');
      console.log(
        `  ${repo.padEnd(15)} ${String(row.calls).padStart(5)} calls / ${String(row.files).padStart(4)} files — ${shapes}`,
      );
    }
    if (skipped.length) console.log(`  not checked out (not counted): ${skipped.join(', ')}`);
    if (grown.length) {
      console.log(
        `\n${grown.length} file(s) over the shrink-only baseline — move the new call onto an @ai-matrx/data door:`,
      );
      for (const g of grown.slice(0, 50)) console.log(`  ${g}`);
      if (grown.length > 50) console.log(`  … ${grown.length - 50} more`);
    }
  }
  // A package with NO baselined call is BLOCKING (it reached zero, or never had one):
  // a new direct call there fails the run even in report-only mode.
  const blocked = blockingGrowth(grown, baseline ?? {});
  if (blocked.length) {
    console.error(
      `\ncheck-db-doors: BLOCKING — ${blocked.length} new direct database call site(s) in packages that are at zero:`,
    );
    for (const g of blocked) console.error(`  ${g}`);
    return 1;
  }
  return args.includes('--strict') && grown.length ? 1 : 0;
}

// Importing this module (tests, other guards) never runs the report.
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(realpathSync(process.argv[1])).href)
  process.exit(main());
